senses.sense_definition: A person or thing that falls behind the rest of a group, such as in a race or during a march.

examples.text: The teacher waited for the last <w>straggler</w> to catch up before continuing the tour.
The marathon runners were exhausted, and the final <w>straggler</w> crossed the finish line long after the winner.

senses.sense_definition: A person who wanders away from their group or deviates from the proper path.

examples.text: The army commander sent scouts to find any <w>straggler</w> who had lost their way in the dense forest.
A small group of <w>straggler</w> soldiers was found hiding in the abandoned village.

senses.sense_definition: A plant or branch that grows or spreads out further than the rest of the plant.

examples.text: I trimmed the long <w>straggler</w> from the rose bush to keep it looking neat.
The gardener cut back every <w>straggler</w> that was growing over the garden path.
